title: Body-Cosmos Correspondence and the Times of Purification
summary: The body-cosmos correspondence provides the structural map of the soul, and on this map the times of purification unfold. T38 expounds the natural mind as one body with every part answering to a faculty of the rational, watched over by five divine watchers. T39 describes how Adam was formed and how the Lord goes down into the small body to bear up what withered. T40 traces how the soul's five faculties are bound in five somatic substrates (bone, sinew, vein, flesh, skin) and exchanged for the New Man. T41 distinguishes the three Great Days of regeneration from the two Deaths. T42 names the three permanent works at the consummation. T43 describes the three afflictions by which the proprium's claim is undone. T44-T46 expound the three malformations: stripped (T44), poured down and drawn up (T45), and purified by descent and ascent (T46).
organizing_principle: The body-cosmos correspondence (T38-T40) establishes the anatomical map; the times of purification (T41-T46) are the temporal-operational unfolding of regeneration upon that map. The threefold pattern dominates — three days, three plundered works, three plagues, three malformations — showing the structural arc of purification working through three operations.
